summary.intent: Check project progress on CipherBox milestone v1.1, review 23 pending todos, and create a new dedicated phase for desktop-FUSE write-durability cleanup based on refactor todos accumulated from Phases 43-44.
summary.outcome: Confirmed milestone v1.1 is fully complete (124/124 plans, 29 phases). Phase 45 ('Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup') was created in ROADMAP.md with enriched scope covering 7 Rust hygiene todos (#11, #12, #14, #15, #18, #19, #20), and STATE.md was updated with a roadmap evolution entry. Changes were committed.

repo: CipherBox milestone v1.1 spans phases 18-44 (29 phases), all complete at 124/124 plans with no UAT debt or active debug sessions.
The SDK todos (#13, #21, #22) are TypeScript SDK (sdk-core + sdk packages + apps/web), not the Rust SDK — easy to confuse given the FUSE/Rust context of adjacent todos.
Todo #22 (folder-state ownership unification) touches both packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web Zustand store/hooks — cross-package TS+web scope, not a simple refactor.
Todo #6 (GitHub Actions Node 24 updates) has a June 2026 deadline — this month — making it time-sensitive despite its low perceived urgency.

The 10 desktop-fuse todos split cleanly into two natures: Rust hygiene refactors (7 items, safe internal restructuring) and data-loss bugs (3 items: #7 mkdir orphan, #8 release() silent loss, #17 stale mount recovery).

code.finding: Contains IPNS CAS-retry logic targeted by todo #21 (unify publishWithCas helper)
Referenced by both todo #13 (baseChildren/publishedChildren bookkeeping leak) and #22 (folder-state ownership unification)
Part of the folder-writes bookkeeping leak scope (todo #13)
Phase 45 section added with enriched goal, depends-on (Phase 43), and 7-plan scope list covering all Rust-only refactor todos
Roadmap evolution entry appended directly after state.add-roadmap-evolution CLI handler failed

workflow: GSD phase addition via `gsd_run query phase.add` auto-creates the directory and inserts a minimal ROADMAP section; the enriched goal/scope/plans content still requires a manual ROADMAP.md edit after creation.
The `state.add-roadmap-evolution` CLI query handler was unreliable in this session; falling back to direct STATE.md edit matching the existing format was the practical workaround.

Scope clarification before creating a phase is worth the extra turn — the 'everything FUSE + SDK' option sounded like Rust but turned out to be cross-language (Rust + TS + web), which would have produced an incoherent phase.

friction: The `state.add-roadmap-evolution` CLI handler was finicky and did not succeed, requiring a direct STATE.md edit as a workaround.

The scope disambiguation flow required extra back-and-forth: the user was presented options, then asked a clarifying question, then lost track of the original options and had to ask to see them again — the options should have stayed visible.
The AskUserQuestion tool was called but the response was not rendered as expected, leading to a generic fallback reply from the assistant before the user re-asked the question.
open_items: Milestone v1.1 needs to be formally closed with `/gsd:complete-milestone` before starting v1.2 work.

Data-loss bugs explicitly deferred from Phase 45: #7 (FUSE mkdir orphans folder on parent publish conflict), #8 (release() reports success then silently loses data), #17 (recover stale FUSE mount after crash on Linux).
Todo #23: updateSharedFile discards prunedCids causing pin leak — data-loss severity, not yet assigned to a phase.
Todo #6: GitHub Actions Node 24 updates — June 2026 deadline, must be addressed this month.
TypeScript SDK refactors deferred: #13 (folder-writes bookkeeping leak), #21 (unify publishWithCas), #22 (folder-state ownership, also touches apps/web Zustand layer).
Security todos deferred: #9 (encrypt share itemName at rest) and #10 (IPNS signature storage review including signedRecord validation and key zeroization).
23 total pending todos need triage before or during the next milestone planning cycle.
